events.title: Makers Market's Local Artist Street Fair

cases.refreshed: November 14, 2026. Makers Market's Local Artist Street Fair is returning to Santana Row! We've rounded up the best local artists, crafters, designers, and makers for a truly unforgettable shopping experience on the second Saturday of every month from 11 AM-6 PM! 60+ local makers offer handmade jewelry, permanent jewelry, ceramics, woodwork, apparel, leather goods, glass art, candles, local honey, apothecary, art, crochet, pet treats/products, handbags, plants, and more. Great food + drinks in the surrounding eateries. This is a sip-and-stroll event! Bring your kids + fur babies. Enjoy live music by local artists. Free to attend! Shop in store! Stroll into our brick-and-mortar shop (adjacent to the market area) for more American-made jewelry, apparel, body products, home goods and more from 100+ makers.
